description: Header file defining data structures, enums, and function prototypes for network model queries related to WAN interface status, physical layer info, and querying mechanisms in a network management context.

methods.name: nm_query_ll_add
methods.description: Adds a link-layer query for the specified WAN mode object.

methods.name: ll_queries_clean
methods.description: Cleans up and frees resources associated with link-layer query info.

methods.name: intf_isup_queries_clean
methods.description: Cleans up and frees resources for interface up status queries.

methods.name: nm_query_mode_active
methods.description: Checks if the network query mode is active.

methods.name: nm_query_create_phys_up_query
methods.description: Creates a physical layer up status query based on link-layer info.

methods.name: nm_close_sensing_queries
methods.description: Closes and cleans up all active sensing queries.
